headline: WhatsApp’s new scheduled messages let you choose the right time to send
summary: WhatsApp adds highly requested message scheduling. Users can now plan messages for private or group chats. This feature brings WhatsApp up to speed with other platforms.

headline: EPA reports ‘zero’ airborne lead following controlled Army detonation in Iowa
summary: US Army detonated over 9,700 pounds of lead azide in Iowa. The controlled explosion prevented a spontaneous blast risk. EPA confirmed 'zero' airborne lead post-detonation.

headline: 1Password breach leaked customer names and emails, but not passwords
summary: 1Password suffered a security breach, exposing customer emails. Passwords and secure vault data remained uncompromised. Affected users face increased risk of phishing attempts.

headline: The Fairphone 6 Plus is modular, repairable, and $100 off right now
summary: Fairphone 6 Plus boasts a modular, repairable design. Easily replaceable parts promise extended phone lifespan. Currently discounted by $98 to $552.49 at Amazon.

headline: 'People Are Doing It Too Quickly Now' — The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Director Speaks Out on YA Franchise Reboots
summary: 'Hunger Games' director Francis Lawrence critiques rapid YA reboots. He discussed industry trends during an interview. Lawrence pondered the future of the 'Hunger Games' franchise.

headline: GTA 6 Doesn't Let You Replay Missions, and Rockstar Says There's a Good Reason for That
summary: Rockstar confirms GTA 6 will not feature mission replays. This decision prioritizes player freedom and story choices. The trade-off enhances the game's dynamic narrative.

headline: The $749 ABS Cyclone RTX 5060 Gaming PC Is More Powerful AND Less Expensive Than the Steam Machine
summary: ABS Cyclone RTX 5060 gaming PC offers strong 1080p performance. Priced at $749, it outperforms and undercuts the Steam Machine. The system allows for easy future upgrades.

headline: 'It Would Be Absolutely Incredible' — Hideki Kamiya Wants to Make a New Castlevania Game With Konami
summary: Devil May Cry creator Hideki Kamiya wants to make a new Castlevania. He believes his team at CLOVERS could create an 'incredible' game. Kamiya hopes to collaborate with Konami on the project.

headline: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
summary: Discount retailer Poundland has entered administration. Its owners failed to secure a buyer for the chain. The collapse puts 11,000 jobs at severe risk.

headline: Why has Poundland collapsed and what happens next?
summary: Poundland collapsed just one year after a £1 acquisition. The article details the reasons behind the retail chain's failure. It also explores the potential next steps for the company.

headline: US announces new tariff proposals on EU, China, and other trade partners
summary: US proposes new tariffs targeting major trade partners. The new levies will impact countries like China and the EU. This move signals a shift in global trade relations.

headline: Wife drugged and raped by husband asked police if she was to blame, mass sexual offence trial hears
summary: A woman drugged and raped by her husband questioned her own blame. She refuted claims of 'pretending to be asleep' in court. Testimony given during a significant sexual offence trial.
